release_rule: Publish a topic only after all 3 of its posters are owner-approved and lesson pages are ready.

lessons.title: Draw Cute Chibi Proportions
lessons.primary_skill: intentional 2–3 head chibi proportion and readable silhouette

lessons.title: Chibi Faces & Expressions
lessons.primary_skill: coordinated brows, eyes, mouth and cheeks for readable chibi emotion

lessons.title: Chibi Poses & Outfits
lessons.primary_skill: simple gesture, balance and outfit silhouette

topics.label: Fairy-Tale Princess
topics.franchise_boundary: Original G-Art Journey princesses only; no Disney naming or recognizable franchise-character copying.

lessons.title: Design a Fairy-Tale Princess
lessons.primary_skill: original princess identity through face, hair silhouette, dress silhouette and motif

lessons.title: Princess Hair, Dress & Royal Details
lessons.primary_skill: hair masses, dress construction, folds and restrained royal details

lessons.title: Graceful Princess Poses
lessons.primary_skill: elegant gesture, hand placement, balance and skirt movement

visual_contract.hierarchy: character-first, generous whitespace, 3–5 major teaching zones
visual_contract.typography: friendly controlled headings; short readable English captions; no oversized bubble lettering
visual_contract.accents: light pastel only; thin separators and restrained callouts
avoid: large saturated color blocks behind every step
tiny anatomy hidden in crowded panels
visual_contract.readability_gate: Normal standalone lesson-page size must be sufficient to understand the poster; View large is optional.

approval_checkpoint.note: Preserve the approved Chibi visual family. Do not regenerate or substitute these three source artworks unless the owner explicitly requests a revision.
